name: Divya Drishti
description: Separated at childhood, Divya and Drishti attain super powers - to not only see the future, but also manipulate it. However, their own future lies in the hands of an evil Pishachini.

videos.title: Sisters With Divine Powers
videos.overview: A tale of two gifted sisters, Divya and Drishti, one can see the future while the other has the power to alter it. However, an evil force, Pishachini, forces them to part ways.

videos.title: Divya Meets Drishti
videos.overview: All grown-up now, Divya and Drishti yearn to reunite. They meet at the fair, unable to recognise each other, while Pishachini lays a deadly trap to catch them!

videos.title: Rakshit Impresses Divya
videos.overview: Divya is impressed by Rakshit after he saved her from drowning, but he likes Drishti. Later, Pishachini plots against Divya and Drishti to keep them away from Rakshit.

videos.title: Pishachini Attacks Divya, Drishti
videos.overview: Pishachini attacks Divya and Drishti, but her magic doesn't work on them. Will she find out their secret? Later, Divya steals Lavanya's engagement ring.

videos.title: Pishachini Learns About Divya
videos.overview: Pishachini learns about Divya's supernatural abilities when she prevents her attack. Later, Drishti's closeness with Rakshit irks Divya.

videos.title: Lavanya Is Bewitched
videos.overview: Bichu uses a spell to enchant Lavanya. He traumatises Rakshit's family disguised as a pandit. Later, Divya is all set to marry Rakshit while Pishachini harasses Drishti.

videos.title: Divya Attacks Pishachini
videos.overview: Drishti gets suspicious when she finds a magical locket in Rakshit's room. Later, Divya attacks Pishachini while Drishti confronts a shocking truth.

videos.title: Drishti Feels Helpless
videos.overview: Drishti envisions Rakshit stabbing Divya to death. Later, he agrees to tie the knot with Divya.

videos.title: Pishachini Kills Chiranjeev
videos.overview: Drishti tricks Rakshit into marrying her. Later, Pishachini kills Chiranjeev while a rude shock awaits Divya.

videos.title: Shekhar to Kill Divya
videos.overview: After joining hands with Pishachini, Shekhar plans to kill Divya on their wedding night. Later, Rakshit secretly follows Drishti and misunderstands her intentions.

videos.title: Pishachini-Mohana Join Hands
videos.overview: Pishachini joins hands with Mohana to do her evil bidding. Meanwhile, Drishti foresees a deadly attack on Divya, can she save her from the cunning witch?

videos.title: Shekhar Saves Divya
videos.overview: Shekhar saves Divya after Mohana attacks her while Drishti is worried. Later, a furious Divya unintentionally hurts Drishti with a knife.

videos.title: Pishachini's Villainous Ploy
videos.overview: Pishachini seeks Shekhar's help to trap Divya in a death well while Lavanya has an argument with Drishti. Meanwhile, Drishti foresees a deceitful event.

videos.title: Drishti, Rakshit Celebrate Holi
videos.overview: At the Holi party, Drishti and Rakshit share a moment while Divya learns about Drishti's identity. Later, trapped by Pishachini, Drishti seeks help for Divya.

videos.title: Pishachini Manages to Escape
videos.overview: Mohana and Bichu save Pishachini from being exposed. Later, Divya, Drishti, and Lavanya engage in a cooking contest while Pishachini does the unthinkable.

videos.title: Pishachini's Evil Ploy
videos.overview: Pishachini stays at the Shergills while Shekhar's health condition raises concern. Later, she executes her evil ploy during the Satsang.

videos.title: Divya-Drishti Reunite
videos.overview: Divya-Drishti have an emotional reunion and decide to hunt their mother's murderer. Meanwhile, Pishachini mistakes Lavanya to be Divya's sister and targets her.

videos.title: Drishti Suspects Rakshit
videos.overview: Pishachini struggles to hide Maanya's corpse. Later, a suspicious Drishti accompanies Rakshit to his office to spy on him.

videos.title: Divya, Drishti Suspect Mahima
videos.overview: Divya and Drishti suspect Mahima's involvement in Vidya's murder while Romi informs them about Chiranjeev. Later, Pishachini targets Mahima to execute her plan.

videos.title: The Sisters Find a Strange Object
videos.overview: Divya and Drishti stumble upon a mysterious object while Pishachini plans to discover Lavanya's real identity. Later, the Shergills are shocked when the police arrive at their doorstep.

videos.title: Pishachini Is in Trouble
videos.overview: Pishachini's eye gets affected when she comes in contact with the holy object. Later, Drishti envisions an event in Rakshit's room that fills her with dread.

videos.title: Drishti Learns a Shocking Truth
videos.overview: Drishti discovers a shocking truth when Pishachini tries to kill Sunny. Later, Rakshit reveals some mysterious facts to Mahima.

videos.title: Chiranjeev's Revealation
videos.overview: Chiranjeev reveals some vital facts to Divya and Drishti about Pishachini. Later, Shekhar's devious plan puts the sisters in danger.

videos.title: Pishachini Is Trapped
videos.overview: Divya and Drishti battle with Pishachini while Romi plans to trap her in a jar. Later, Romi makes a shocking revelation to Drishti while Pishachini plays her mastercard.

videos.title: What is Drishti Suspicious About?
videos.overview: A suspicious Drishti tells Divya that she gained a new power. Later, Divya traps her while Romi is worried about Pishachini's missing ash.

videos.title: Drishti in Trouble?
videos.overview: The Shergills plan a family picnic while Shekhar misleads Rakshit. Later, Rakshit is concerned about Drishti as she receives help from an unexpected source.

videos.title: Divya to Kill Shekhar
videos.overview: Divya attacks Shekhar but Drishti saves him. Later, Mahima wants Rakshit to marry Lavanya while Drishti discovers some puzzling facts.

videos.title: Rakshit Doubts Drishti
videos.overview: Drishti tries to help Divya while Rakshit gets very suspicious of the former. Later, as a desperate attempt, Drishti sets fire to the room she is in.

videos.title: Drishti on a Mission
videos.overview: Drishti, Romi and Shekhar sneak into Pishachini's room to destroy the magical ash. Will they be successful in eliminating her?

videos.title: Drishti to Kill Divyachini?
videos.overview: Divyachini plans to kill Drishti to become invincible. Later, Drishti strikes her with the magical knife, is this the end of Pishachini?

videos.title: Pishachini Is Diddled
videos.overview: Anjaan hands over the Kaalvijay Ratna to Pishachini while Divya and Drishti battle for their lives. Later, Pishachini is puzzled by the gem's attributes.

videos.title: Pishachini's Sinister Ploy
videos.overview: Simran's health deteriorates while Pishachini comes up with a diabolical plan to kill the Shergills. Later, Anjaan reveals his true identity.

videos.title: Pishachini's Quest for the Jewel
videos.overview: Pishachini instructs Anjaan to do her evil bidding after Divya and Drishti discover a shocking truth. Later, Pishachini is adamant to acquire the Kaal Vijay Ratna.

videos.title: Rakshit Asks for a Divorce
videos.overview: In order to help Simran, Divya and Drishti plan to steal Pisachini's locket. Later, Rakshit asks Drishti for a divorce.

videos.title: New Enemy Alert
videos.overview: Divya and Drishti struggle with a mysterious riddle. Later, Pishachini determines to foil their efforts as a new enemy unfolds itself.

videos.title: Lavanya's Evil Intentions
videos.overview: Pishachini instructs Lavanya to poison Rakshit while he struggles to save Divya and Drishti. Later, a drunk Drishti foresees a new danger.

videos.title: Rakshit, Drishti Get Intimate
videos.overview: Rakshit and Drishti spend romantic moments while Lavanya informs Pisachini about her plans. Later, Drishti confides in Divya about her deepest fears.

videos.title: Pishachini's Master Plan
videos.overview: Rakshit's confession stuns Drishti while Lavanya learns a way to drain the sisters' powers. Later, Pishachini hatches a secret plan to acquire the Kaalvijay Ratna.

videos.title: Rakshit to Save Drishti?
videos.overview: Divya is suspicious of Lavanya's actions while Pishachini hinders Rakshit's search for Drishti. Later, Mahima wields a sword to kill a family member.

videos.title: Mahima Is Being Manipulated
videos.overview: Mahima, under Pishachini's influence, attempts to attack an old man. Later, Pishachini startles the family with shocking revelations.

videos.title: Lavanya Acquires the Gem!
videos.overview: Divya and Drishti execute their masterplan against Pishachini while Rakshit tries to cure his father, Chetan. Later, Lavanya quietly steals the gem.

videos.title: Divya, Romi to Expose Lavanya
videos.overview: Divya and Romi plan to expose Lavanya during the masquerade while Simran converts into a human bomb. Later, an intoxicated Lavanya creates a scene at the party.

videos.title: Divya, Drishti to Save Simran
videos.overview: Divya and Drishti find a way to save Simran. Later, Divya attacks Pishachini while Lavanya poisons the Shergills.

videos.title: Divya's Devious Trick
videos.overview: While Divya tricks Pishachini into believing her lie, Drishti kills Lavanya. Later, the Shergills execute their masterplan to trap Pishachini.

videos.title: Drishti's Unexpected Request
videos.overview: Drishti foresees a mass murder while the Shergills plan to torture Pishachini on an ice slab. Later, a devastated Drishti makes a shocking request to Rakshit.

videos.title: Pishachini, Kanch Rani Team Up
videos.overview: Pishachini seeks Kanch Rani's help when the Shergills try to trap her. As Kanch Rani takes Drishti's form, will they realise the ruse before it's too late?

videos.title: Kaanch Rani Traps the Shergills
videos.overview: Rakshit, Divya and Romi attack Pishachini while she tortures Drishti. Later, Kaanch Rani traps the Shergills in the mirror as Pishachini's ploy troubles Rakshit.

videos.title: Pishachini Wreaks Havoc
videos.overview: Drishti struggles to save the Shergills from Pishachini's magical trap. Later, Pishachini acquires the Kaalvijay Ratna and attacks them with her immense power.

videos.title: Rakshit, Drishti Get Intimate
videos.overview: Rakshit and Drishti get intimate while Rahasyatara reveals a startling fact about the ratnas. Later, the sisters are given a deadly ultimatum by a temple guardian.

videos.title: Pishachini's Masterstroke
videos.overview: While Pishachini goes to brutal lengths to acquire the gem, Kaal Devta presents her with a gift. Later, Divya struggles to save the Shergills from Daitya Vanar.

videos.title: Betaal Challenges Drishti
videos.overview: Betaal puts forth a tough challenge in front of Drishti for the magical Kamandal. Later, the Shergils are bewildered when they identify the real Daitya Vaanar.

videos.title: The Sisters Celebrate Raksha Bandhan
videos.overview: Pishachini plans to incinerate the Shergils during the Independence Day function while Rakshit confesses his love to Drishti. Later, Divya and Drishti celebrate Raksha Bandhan.

videos.title: Betaal Challenges Divya, Drishti
videos.overview: Betaal agrees to free the kids, provided Divya and Drishti answer his riddles. Elsewhere, Daitya Vaanar wreaks chaos at the party.

videos.title: Divya Attacks the Daitya Vanar
videos.overview: Divya and Drishti struggle with Betaal's riddles while Romi reveals Shekhar's evil intentions to them. Later, Divya gets into a fierce battle with the Daitya Vanar.

videos.title: Divya, Drishti Sacrifice Their Lives
videos.overview: Divya and Drishti sacrifice their lives to stop Pishachini from acquiring the powers of the gem. Later, a creature from hell meets Pishachini while she tortures the Shergills.

videos.title: Divya, Drishti to Strike Back
videos.overview: Divya and Drishti attain new powers and vow to destroy Pishachini while Rakshit regains consciousness. How will things unfold now?

videos.title: Divya, Drishti's Clever Disguise
videos.overview: Pishachini enters the Shergill Mansion claiming to be Rakshit's wife. However, Divya and Drishti, disguised as locals, manage to learn about her plan.

videos.title: Divya, Drishti Fool Pishachini
videos.overview: A disguised Divya and Drishti trick Pishachini when she takes a dangerous step to find them. Later, an infuriated Pishachini wreaks havoc on the Shergills.

videos.title: Divya, Drishti's Covert Operation
videos.overview: Divya and Drishti save the Shergills from Pishachini's fatal trap while the latter is clueless. Unable to accept defeat, Pishachini brews a poisonous lassi.

videos.title: Divya, Drishti on a Quest
videos.overview: After learning a shocking secret about Pishachini, Divya and Drishti set out to find a magical tree. Later, Kal Devta attacks Rakshit.

videos.title: Divya, Drishti in Grave Danger
videos.overview: While the Shergills perform Ganesh Visarjan, Pishachini plans to drown Divya and Drishti as well. Later, Kaal Devta assigns Pishachini a strange task.

videos.title: Rakshit Regains His Memory?
videos.overview: Rakshit struggles to regain his memory. Later, Narayan and Mahadev are concerned about Divya and Drishti after the sisters get into a heated argument.

videos.title: Rakshit Behaves Strangely
videos.overview: The Shergills are stunned by Rakshit's strange behaviour as he strangles Romi. Later, Divya and Drishti get into a sword fight at the mall.

videos.title: Pishachini Is Pregnant?
videos.overview: Pishachini stuns Divya and Drishti by revealing her pregnancy after an epic battle. Later, the sisters get a dire prophecy while a magical army approaches.

videos.title: Patali's Fierce Attack
videos.overview: Pishachini returns home with her newly born daughter, Patali. Later, the evil duo wreak havoc at the Shergills.

videos.title: Patali's Stern Warning
videos.overview: Patali gives the family a stern warning while Chetak's death leaves Rakshit heartbroken. Later, Romi's encounter with Patali spells trouble for her.

videos.title: Rakshit Regains His Memory
videos.overview: Rakshit shares a romantic moment with Drishti after regaining his memory. On the eve of Divya and Drishti's birthday, the sisters execute a clever distraction.

videos.title: Divya, Drishti to Kill Patali
videos.overview: Divya brings Patali's heart from hell after a fierce fight with the demons. Later, Pishachini and Patali are terrified when Divya and Drishti decide to destroy the heart.

videos.title: Divya, Drishti to Counter Patali
videos.overview: Patali becomes violent after regaining her power while Divya and Drishti brew a new plan to counter her. Later, Rakshit and Drishti get romantic.

videos.title: Birthday Bash for the Sisters
videos.overview: Patali tortures the Shergills while Rakshit decides to meet his private detectives. Pishachini puts forth a challenge during Divya and Dristhi's birthday party.

videos.title: Shekhar Is Found?
videos.overview: Divya is worried by some strange visions while Pishachini gets news from Pataal Lok. Later, the Shergills are overwhelmed when they come across Shekhar.

videos.title: Patali Flirts With Shekhar
videos.overview: Patali flirts with Shekhar while Pisachini doubts his intentions. Later, the Shergills stage a play with Shekhar and Divya as the leads.

videos.title: Patali's Evil Ploy
videos.overview: Patali drinks a magical potion to take the form of Divya. Later, Pishachini learns the truth about Shekhar while Rakshit and Drishti share a romantic dance.

videos.title: Shekhar Is Accused
videos.overview: Pishachini accuses Shekhar after he saves Divya's life. Later, Rakshit and Drishti get into an argument while Pishachini makes a shocking discovery.

videos.title: Divya Is in Trouble
videos.overview: The Shergills enjoy a picnic at their farmhouse while Pishachini uses her magical powers to create a weapon. Later, Divya lands in trouble after Patali's death.

videos.title: Divya's Trial Begins
videos.overview: Pishachini manipulates the evidence after Divya's trial starts in Kaal Devta's court. While the fake Shekhar misleads the Shergills, Drishti has an idea.

videos.title: The Shergills on a Mission
videos.overview: Shekhar enters the Devadi to obtain Patali's body. Later, the Shergills hatch a brilliant plan while Pishachini gets suspicious of them.

videos.title: The End for Divya?
videos.overview: Pishachini learns the truth about Patali and summons Kaal Devta. Later, Kaal Devta curses Divya and condemns her to hell as punishment.

videos.title: Drishti Is Inconsolable
videos.overview: An inconsolable Drishti is desperate to save Divya from being tortured in hell. Meanwhile, Pishachini puts forth an evil plan before Shekhar.

videos.title: Divya Falls in Danger
videos.overview: Rakshit strikes a deal with Pishachini for Divya and Drishti after getting Patali's heart. Meanwhile, Divya's life is in grave danger.

videos.title: The Shergills on a New Mission
videos.overview: The Shergills give a birthday surprise to Shekhar. While on a mission to protect their ancestral haveli, Shekhar and Rakshit discover a shocking truth.

videos.title: Divya, Drishti's Odd Discovery
videos.overview: Drishti discovers a shocking truth about the bikers during their attempt to burn the Haveli. While the zombies capture Rakshit, Divya gets suspicious of Shekhar.

videos.title: Divya, Drishti's Horrific Ordeal
videos.overview: The Shergills enjoy a late-night party while Divya and Shekhar get romantic. Later, the sisters witness a nightmarish event when they get sucked into a magical book.

videos.title: Drishti, Divya Find the Cave
videos.overview: Divya and Drishti encounter a problem after finding the cave while Shekhar gets suspicious about Vicky. Later, the family shocks Divya with a marriage proposal.

videos.title: Drishti Realises the Truth
videos.overview: Divya agrees to marry Vicky while Drishti fights off a werewolf in the forest. Later, Drishti realises the truth about Shekhar and resolves to expose him.

videos.title: Shekhar Confesses the Truth!
videos.overview: Ashlesha collapses after learning about Shekhar's true identity. While the Shergills gear up for Divya and Vicky's marriage, Drishti makes a shocking discovery.

videos.title: Drishti to Save Rakshit
videos.overview: Vicky wreaks havoc in the wedding as Divya, Rakshit and Drishti are lost deep within the woods. When danger strikes, Drishti sets out to save Rakshit.

videos.title: Shekhar Is Desperate
videos.overview: Divya witnesses a strange phenomenon in the forest. Later, Shekhar desperately tries to convince the Shergills while Chikki's true intentions are revealed.

videos.title: Terrible News for the Shergills
videos.overview: Despite Mahima's warning, Rakshit tries to enter the mysterious cave. While an evil entity attacks Pishachini, Mahima blames Rakshit for Rashi's death.

videos.title: Pishachini, Chikki Join Hands
videos.overview: Divya and Drishti lose their vision and get stuck in the past after Pishachini burns the holy book. Later, Chikki and Pishachini lay a trap to mislead them.

videos.title: Divya, Drishti Are Tensed
videos.overview: The Shergills console Divya and Drishti while Pishachini and Chikki are on a secret mission. Later, Chikki locks Rakshit and Shekhar in the storeroom.

videos.title: Divya, Drishti Face a Challenge
videos.overview: As the clock counts down to New Years, Divya and Drishti attempt to identify the real Rakshit and Shekhar among many duplicates. Can they do it in time?

videos.title: Divya, Shekhar Get Hitched
videos.overview: Rakshit and Drishti discover some antique scripts and books while sharing a romantic moment. Elsewhere, Divya and Shekhar tie the knot.

videos.title: Divya, Shekhar's Wedding Rituals
videos.overview: An infuriated Lal Chakor wreaks havoc and attacks Pishachini. Later, Ashlesha slaps Shekhar before his post-wedding rituals commence with Divya.

videos.title: The Sisters' Secret Mission
videos.overview: Divya and Drishti are on a secret mission after learning a shocking fact regarding their mother's death. Later, a party is organised at the Shergill Mansion.

videos.title: Pishachini Traps the Shergills
videos.overview: As Drishti is about to break the news of her pregnancy, Pishachini traps the Shergills within the house. Later, Divya and Drishti investigate the Lal Chakor story.

videos.title: Tough Time for the Shergills
videos.overview: After Mahima's death, Pishachini loses her eyesight. While Lal Chakor targets Ashlesha, the Shergills grow suspicious of Monty's activities.

videos.title: Pishachini's Extraordinary Dance
videos.overview: While the Shegills are taken aback by Monty's sudden death, Drishti witnesses a strange vision. Later, Pishachini stuns the family with her extraordinary dance.

videos.title: Pishachini's Diabolical Ploy
videos.overview: Pishachini and the Lal Chakor do the unthinkable with Rakshit's magical sword. Later, the Shergills attempt to fight their way out of a tight spot.

videos.title: Drishti Consoles Rakshit
videos.overview: Divya's life is in peril when she executes a risky plan. After learning Lal Chakor's real identity, a devastated Rakshit finds solace in Drishti's arms.

videos.title: Rakshit's Violent Outburst
videos.overview: Rakshit turns violent after learning a shocking fact about Mahima. Later, Divya and Drishti make an unimaginable sacrifice for the family.

videos.title: Divya and Drishti Are Dead?
videos.overview: During the Shanti puja, the Shergills witness some strange occurrences. Later, the family tricks Mahima and Pishachini while Rakshit learns a shocking fact.

videos.title: Divya, Drishti Meet Guruji
videos.overview: Guruji attempts to rescue Drishti from Mahima's deadly attack. Later, he puts forth a heartfelt request when the sisters find themselves in a magical realm.

videos.title: Drishti Is Blessed With Twins
videos.overview: Guruji makes a stunning prediction while Mahima and Pishachini get into a heated argument. Later, the family share a tender moment as Drishti is blessed with twins!

videos.title: Kaal Devta's Shocking Identity
videos.overview: In a shocking turn of events, Kaal Devta reveals his identity as he approaches Drishti's twin babies. Later, Mahima tries to kill Rakshit with a magical sword.

videos.title: Divya, Drishti's Last Fight
videos.overview: While the Shergills are shocked to learn Kaal Devta's true identity, Pishachini fulfils her wish. Can Divya, Drishti win this last war?
